zh.headline: 跨國大型電商、企業系統整合與百人研發治理的實戰派技術長 (CTO) & 企業首席顧問
zh.subHeadline: 歷練 70–300+ 人跨國研發組織、全球零售 SAP 電商中台與 Fortune 500 跨系統整合——協助董事會與 CEO 將複雜技術債轉化為高可用商業引擎與實質營收。

body.text: 我是具備跨國大型企業架構治理與第一線系統工程實力的 Hands-on CTO 與企業首席技術顧問。企業真正願意付高薪與長期顧問費解決的，從來不是華麗的流行口號，而是「跨國高併發電商撐不住大促流量、CRM/ERP/供應鏈系統各自為政、重度技術債拖垮產品交付、以及百人工程團隊缺乏商業產出」。過去十餘年，我最高管理超過 300 人規模之科技與工程體系，並親自率領 70 人純軟體研發軍團交付全球最大健康美容零售集團 SAP 電商平台與 Fortune 500 跨國 CRM/ERP 中樞；同時至今仍維持每日親手架構量化金融引擎、高併發資料管線與複雜規則系統的實戰手感。
三大高階合作模式 (Executive & Advisory Engagement)
1. 年度企業技術顧問 / Fractional CTO（一年期常駐顧問約）
專為尋求大型電商升級、跨系統整合、技術債重構或處於高速擴張期的上市櫃企業與高成長公司設計。以年度合約（Annual Retainer）形式，每月固定參與高層技術決策、核心系統架構把關、CRM/ERP/電商資料流打通、雲端成本優化，以及協助 CEO 面試、考核與培育核心技術主管（VP / Director / Architect）。
2. 高階技術長正職 / 研發副總（CTO / VP of Engineering）
開放具規模願景之跨國企業、大型零售電商集團、金融科技或高成長科技公司之高階技術領導職缺（Target Package: 年薪 NT$ 300萬+ / Global Executive Compensation）。全面執掌技術戰略、50–300+ 人跨國研發組織治理、全通路高併發商業平台重構與研發交付效能轉型。
3. 創投盡職調查與系統危機救援（Tech Due Diligence & Architecture Rescue）
為創投機構 (VC / PE)、家族辦公室與企業董事會提供融資與併購前的獨立第三方「技術盡職調查」——穿透檢視標的之原始碼品質、架構擴展極限、團隊真實交付能力、資安合規與技術護城河真偽；或針對面臨大促銷高併發崩潰、跨系統資料斷鏈與嚴重技術債之核心系統提供專案診斷與重構救援。
跨國企業與旗艦系統實戰成績單
全球最大健康與美容零售集團（親帶 70+ 人研發軍團）：主導 SAP Commerce Cloud 跨國高併發電商平台與微服務中台重構，打通多幣別結帳、全通路會員與即時庫存同步，扛住跨國大促銷極限流量，系統可用度達 99.98%。
Fortune 500 全球消費性電子品牌（跨國多系統治理）：深度整合 Salesforce Service Cloud、HubSpot、RingCentral 語音中繼與全球 ERP 庫存與售後 RMA 中樞，消滅跨部門資料孤島，將全球退換貨流轉週期由「數天」壓縮至「數分鐘」，營運效率提升 42%。

獨立架構之高難度量化金融、自動化媒體與複雜規則引擎主系統：不靠簡報空談，親手打造並線上運行 5 大高複雜度主力系統——涵蓋 888 StockBot 2.0 機構級量化估值與籌碼穿透系統（純 TS 實作 DCF、Minervini SEPA、期權損益）、888 StockQuant 雙時序模型預測平台、888news 百大信源自動化情報雷達、DAVID888 Daily 自動化語音媒體基建，以及高日活之 333 奇門遁甲古曆法確定性規則引擎。
合作形式：一年期企業技術顧問約 (Annual Retainer)｜高階正職 (CTO / VP of Engineering)｜創投與董事會技術盡職調查 (Tech DD)。謝絕博弈、資金盤與非法灰產項目。

en.headline: Enterprise CTO & Principal Technical Advisor: Global eCommerce, Cross-System Architecture & 300+ Org Leadership
en.subHeadline: From global SAP eCommerce platforms and Fortune 500 CRM/ERP integration to leading 70–300+ person engineering organizations—helping Boards and CEOs turn complex technical debt into resilient commercial engines.

body.text: I am a hands-on Chief Technology Officer and Principal Technical Advisor with deep expertise in global e-commerce architecture, enterprise system integration, and large-scale engineering governance. Boards and CEOs do not pay executive compensation for buzzwords—they invest in leaders who can prevent high-concurrency e-commerce outages, unify fragmented CRM/ERP/supply-chain data silos, refactor crippling technical debt, and align 70–300+ engineers around commercial delivery. Over the past decade, I have scaled organizations of 300+ staff and directly led 70-engineer software teams delivering global retail e-commerce and Fortune 500 operational hubs, while remaining a hands-on chief architect who builds institutional quantitative engines, high-throughput data pipelines, and deterministic rule systems.
Executive Engagement & Advisory Models
1. Annual Enterprise Technical Advisor / Fractional CTO (12-Month Retainer)

Designed for listed corporations, omni-channel retail leaders, and scaling ventures undergoing platform modernization or cross-system integration. Under an annual retainer, I partner directly with the CEO and Board on architecture governance, e-commerce & CRM/ERP data unification, cloud cost optimization, technical debt elimination, and hiring/vetting senior engineering leaders (VP / Director / Principal Architect).
2. Full-Time Executive Leadership (CTO / VP of Engineering)

Available for high-impact Chief Technology Officer or VP of Engineering mandates (Target: NT$ 3M+ / Global Executive Compensation Package). Full technical and organizational ownership across multi-center engineering orgs (50–300+ engineers), high-concurrency commercial platform modernization, and high-velocity product delivery.
3. VC / PE Tech Due Diligence & Architecture Rescue

Independent third-party technical due diligence for Venture Capital, Private Equity, Family Offices, and Corporate M&A—auditing codebase health, scalability ceilings, team execution velocity, security posture, and architectural defensibility before capital deployment. Also available for emergency architecture rescue on bottlenecked production systems.
Track Record & Flagship Production Systems

Global #1 Health & Beauty Retail Group (Led 70+ Engineers): Spearheaded SAP Commerce Cloud and event-driven microservices transformation across international markets, unifying multi-currency checkout, omni-channel loyalty, and real-time inventory synchronization with 99.98% uptime.

Fortune 500 Global Consumer Electronics Brand (Enterprise Integration): Unified Salesforce Service Cloud, HubSpot, RingCentral voice infrastructure, and global ERP/RMA inventory hubs—slashing RMA turnaround from days to minutes and boosting operational efficiency by 42%.

Self-Architected Quantitative Finance, High-Throughput Media & Rule Engine Systems: Hands-on architect of 5 live production systems on .david888.com—including 888 StockBot 2.0 (native TypeScript DCF valuation, Minervini SEPA, options Greeks, and institutional chip flow penetration), 888 StockQuant (TimesFM & Timestral dual time-series forecasting), 888news (autonomous 100+ source intelligence radar), DAVID888 Daily (automated audio media & RSS infrastructure), and 333 Qi Men Dun Jia (high-DAU deterministic astronomical rule engine).
Engagement: 12-Month Advisory Retainer | Full-Time CTO / VP of Engineering | Board & VC Tech Due Diligence. Strictly no gambling, illicit crypto schemes, or unregulated exchange projects.
